regions.merged_text: If there is a blessing of any kind to come from atheism - in itself the Climax of insanity - it will be this Unity among those professing to believe in God. After all, if Religion can be defined as: "The science of relationship between God and the rational creature, and dependence of the latter on his Creator - and his neighbor - then religion must be one, and whatever is contrary to that unity is opposed to that peace between men themselves and God their Creator that ought to permiate human society - the peace of which the Good God Himself, through the Apostle assures us "surpasseth all understanding" - the peace that the Divine Ruler of the universe will no doubt establish between men and nations even at the cost of hells on earth before that peace be perfected.
